context.description: The runner holds no hand-written lifecycle state

evidence.trustReason: Fresh-context review of verify-spec-SV1.spec.ts at HEAD f57285510d (sha256 prefix f9ae7f1d4d6896cb); my own bun run: 8 pass, 0 fail, 43 expect(). Given the harness source after phase 2: asserts core/runner.ts is absent, no module imports a runner, and the scan covers command, harness, recorder, workers, hooks, sessions and the three supervise/ files. When it is inspected: a TypeScript-AST scan of every .ts file under src/task by construct kind (not by name only), with a negative control over a planted source that must flag each construct, so a blind scan fails. Then no polled loop / tick counter: polls equal exactly the two AD-17 entries (proof/process.ts appender, awaitGroupGone; spine AD-17 lists both), no module-level let/var, no let outside a function. Stale cadence counter: STALE_EVERY absent by name; the cadence is the run supervisor's xstate after row waiting->checking with delay 1000 ms (config asserted). Failure map: no Ref/MutableHashMap/HashMap/Map/Set anywhere. Failure limit: MAX_FAILURES absent; the three FAILURE_LIMIT uses sit in xstate guards over a context count. This reading is correct: T2.12 names MAX_FAILURES, and SV6 requires a 3-failure rule, which xstate now holds. Stopping flag, children list, worker FiberMap: no stopping/stopped/children/failures/active/registry held mutably, no FiberMap/FiberSet/FiberHandle, no forked fiber kept in a collection; the fork sites are pinned. Judged-state list: no state-name list outside the AD-17 entries. Process-wide run registry: the only module collections are the two WeakMap<Plan> memos. I cross-checked the source by grep and read harness.ts: leases and the session index live in the harness root actor context. And a live run found through the actor system: the real /task command with the real BackgroundJob registry starts a run; harness.system.get(run:<id>) is Some and its snapshot context.run.id equals the id; task:<id>:T1.1 is found too; a second harness root does not see it, even with a lease; after the job cancel the system holds neither. No gap found.
